IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_1: Fuck... I hear a horde nearby. I think they're coming here.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_2: Shit. That's not just wandering. They're heading this way!
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_3: Great. A whole damn crowd, and of course they found me.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_4: I hear them. Too many footsteps... way too close.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_5: I heard something over there. I should stay careful.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_6: Goddamn wanderers. Why can't you just die? Oh, right. They're already dead.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_7: Yeah, fuckers! Come and get me!
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_8: I like company, but not that sort of company.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Normal_9: Hey... I know that one. Gotta give them a proper burial.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_1: Fuck, fuck, fuck... I really don't like the sound of that.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_2: Shit... sounds like the whole city is coming for my ass.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_3: God damn it, why right now? Fight them or run?
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_4: No. That's not a horde. That's a fucking wall of dead.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_5: This sounds like grave trouble. Should've written a will earlier.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Cataclysm_6: Fuuuuuuck! I'll need a good bottle of whiskey after this... if I survive.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_1: Hold on... that's a moving horde. Maybe I can stay quiet.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_2: Shit. They're passing through. Don't make a sound.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_3: That's a lot of dead on the move. Better let them pass.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_4: Keep it quiet... maybe they won't notice me.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_5: That's my neighborhood. Hope they don't stay long. Better not provoke them.
IGUI_DHE_Speech_Wandering_6: Is there a parade or what? I don't feel like joining. Better stay quiet.
